items.statement: The submitted investigation validates all four labeled states and makes the energy-to-observable derivation auditable.
items.expected: Per-state validation, charge/spin and method metadata are present; an energy ledger and formulas support every requested observable.

items.statement: The two requested oxidation-potential couples are quantitatively determined on a stated reference scale.
items.expected: Values are approximately +1.33 V for 1/2 and −0.54 V for 3/4 vs SCE in MeCN.

items.statement: The two requested C–H BDEs are quantitatively determined with units.
items.expected: Values are approximately 76.1 and 32.9 kcal/mol for labeled species 1 and 2.
